[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Carisica Vanq''' was a wealthy [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who lived in an [[Carisica Vanq's estate|estate]] in [[Danteel City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Danteel]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She owned a collection of rare artifacts, among which was a valuable [[Tchine]] sculpture. She also became a business rival of the financier and [[Casino/Legends|casino]] owner [[Veilred Jydor]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Vanq was [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rovi]] a single [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt to her upper torso. Rovi's employer, the business manager [[Darim Chumu]], hoped to frame Jydor for her death and Rovi left behind a forged note purportedly written by Vanq, accusing Jydor of being her killer.
